Priya S.: Hey folks — quick coverage ask for a Sr Infra on Tue 9:00am PT (45m). Panel ideally: Samir, Elena, Jamal + optional PM. Can someone confirm scribe + debrief owner? Candidate is on NDA so please no screenshots or recordings outside the posted Zoom consent.
Samir P.: I can interview but I have a standing at 9:15. Would 9:00–9:45 still work? otherwise I can do 9:30–10:15.
Elena M.: I can keep 9:00 slot. Happy to scribe if needed but prefer to interview.
Jamal R.: I can interview and take debrief owner. Can't scribe that day.
Priya S.: Awesome — @Hiring Ops can you handle scribe assignment? also @People Ops Bot can you add recording consent note and attach the infra debrief template to the calendar invite? :pray:
People Ops Bot: Recording consent line added to event description. Infra debrief template attached. Reminder 30m before.
Hiring Ops: Assigned scribe -> Angela T. Debrief owner -> Jamal R. Rubric guidance for this role: prioritize system design & reliability (60%) over implementation (40%). Quick cheat: `sysdesign: scalability, tradeoffs, observability; code: correctness, readability`.
Angela T.: Got it — I'll scribe and capture links to any whiteboard/code snippets, and post notes in /hiring/debriefs.
Priya S.: Thanks — one more: please use the 'Infrastructure' debrief template, and tag any security concerns in the "red-flags" section. Also can someone paste the candidate's take-home repo link in this thread 15m before the call?
Samir P.: Will drop the repo link ~15m prior.
Elena M.: Quick ask on scoring — are we keeping the numeric rubric (1-5) + short comment, or switching to the new pass/needs-work flag for this hire?
Hiring Ops: Stick with numeric 1-5 + one-line comment for this loop (we're trialing pass/needs-work later).
Jamal R.: Agree on numeric. Also let's keep post-call debrief to comments + scores only — no subjective convo threads in the candidate channel.
Priya S.: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup: See you Tue.
Samir P.: Thanks — I'll post repo link at 8:45 PT.
Angela T.: I'll set up the Google doc and share it to the invite.
